subject.title: feat(worktrees): configurable cleanup limits (max count, max total size) with Settings UI

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `worktrees.cleanup.maxCount` and `worktrees.cleanup.maxTotalSizeGb` as global opt-in retention policy with snapshot-first automatic eviction?
rationale: This adds durable operator-facing configuration and an automated destructive policy, so tests cannot determine whether both fields and their permanent semantics match maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept both limits
options.body: Keep both fields unset by default, require hot application and real-Gateway eviction-and-restore proof, then land after a clean rebase.

options.title: Ship count only
options.body: Reduce the initial contract and runtime cost by deferring recursive total-size enforcement.

options.title: Decline config expansion
options.body: Retain idle cleanup and pursue disk-pressure warnings or manual cleanup without new persistent settings.

recommendation.title: Accept both limits
recommendation.body: Keep both fields unset by default, require hot application and real-Gateway eviction-and-restore proof, then land after a clean rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the current managed-worktree runtime owner, but the available evidence could not identify that person reliably.
